verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product AI insights or suggestions feature in Airwallex. AgentOS (docs-13) is a toolkit that lets external AI agents act on the account, for example building cashflow reports. That is a developer building block for outside agents, not AI-generated insights delivered inside the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
